title: Seacrest Beach "30A Ocean Beachfront" and "30A Sandy Beachfront" 8220 E County Hwy 30A Units A&B
h1: Seacrest Beach "30A Ocean Beachfront" and "30A Sandy Beachfront" 8220 E County Hwy 30A Units A&B
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf front- Private Pool & Sitting Spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $100 per day* Pool chiller runs complimentary in July and August- 180 Degree Gulf Views from All 3 Floors- Private Beach Walkover- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 8 beach chairs and 4 umbrellas (Service provided March 1 - October 31)- Elevator Between All Three Floors *(30A Ocean Beachfront only)- Sonos Sound System & HDTVs- Outdoor Natural Gas Grill- 12 Adult bikes- 2 6-Seater Low-Speed Vehicles- Peloton bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Delight in an idyllic Gulf-front getaway at 30A Ocean Beachfront and 30A Sandy Beachfront. Nestled in the dunes of Seacrest Beach, spend blissful days basking in the sun on white-sand beaches and relishing the tantalizing cuisine of local eateries. With sublime views of the tranquil Gulf waters from the private pool and a private walkover leading to the beach behind both homes, guests are set to experience the vacation of a lifetime. Discover immaculate interiors infused with chic beach accents and polished Travertine tile floors in the open-concept great rooms of both homes. Sliding glass doors with delightful views of the shimmering Gulf create an ethereal backdrop, perfect for entertaining guests. Luxury Thermador appliances in the spacious, fully equipped kitchens tempt cooks of every level to craft a delectable meal. Both homes feature 8-person dining tables and seating at the kitchen breakfast bar. Plush, double sofas in the living area invite guests to unwind, and the 65” Smart TV and Sonos soundbar set the stage for unlimited entertainment. Outside, an enchanting oasis with 2 natural gas grills, comfortable seating areas, alfresco dining tables, and private pools offer the ultimate spot to savor the sun and salt-tinged air.Perfect for large families and groups, the beach homes collectively provide exceptional accommodations for 34 guests with a total of 11 bedrooms and 8 full bathrooms. A mix of pleasant bunk rooms, elegant guest bedrooms, distinguished primary bedrooms, and patios with Gulf views are on each of the levels.Revel in the captivating Gulf-front beauty of 30A Ocean Beachfront and 30A Sandy Beachfront. Private parking is available for 6 compact vehicles, plus 12 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle. A private beach walkover leads to a public beach off the back patios. Book these phenomenal beach homes today!30A Ocean Beachfront:SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin BedsSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed30A Sandy Beachfront:SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 17):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: One Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Two Full-over-Queen Bunk Beds, and a Twin Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Please note that Gulf-front bonfires are not permitted at this location per Walton County regulations.*The beach before 30A Ocean Beachfront and 30A Sandy Beachfront is not privately owned.*Pool heat for Unit A is unavailable when temps drop below 50°F. This is to protect the pool heater in cold temperatures.
